audit.why: 53.31% WR over 741 games for Naafiri. Dash-less control mage: lane and mid-game are Naafiri's, 2+ items tips to Orianna via shield, zoning and Shockwave. EVEN 5.5/10 fits.

audit.why: Her E shield (9s CD, grants armor/MR) and 410-range Shockwave scale into reliable dive answers; before that her ball out on the wave leaves her peel-less.

audit.whatIsWrong: Twelve misgender hits (Orianna is she/her). Naafiri's dash again called 'W The Hunt' / 'W dive' — per kit W is the untargetable pack-empower and R is the champion dash. Cooldowns field had no digits despite Ori's Q hitting 3s at rank 5.
audit.why: Kit authority. Her Q is 7s down to 3, W a flat 7s, E a flat 9s, R 110/95/80 — trade windows key off ball position plus those numbers.
audit.corrected: Pronouns fixed, W/R naming corrected, real cooldowns written.

edits.before: Orianna controls space with her ball, but early her mana and cooldowns are tight, so your Q charges plus W The Hunt beat her in short trades. Step up when her ball is out on the wave rather than on her, because a ball far from Orianna means her Q-W poke and shield are out of position. Chunk her with Q daggers and W in when she's low on mana; she can't kite you without the ball on herself.

edits.before: Her R Command: Shockwave is a game-changing teamfight tool but in a 1v1 it's just a displacement, and your R Call of the Pack plus E Eviscerate let you all-in through it. Wait for her ball to be committed to the wave, then W The Hunt onto her; she has no dash and can't peel a full pack. Six is still your window as long as you don't W into a ball sitting on her for the shield-plus-shockwave combo.
edits.after: Her R Command: Shockwave is a game-changing teamfight tool but in a 1v1 it's just a displacement, and your R dive plus E dash-heal let you all-in through it. edits.before: At 2+ items Orianna out-scales you: her ball gives constant zoning, her shield eats your burst, and R Command: Shockwave punishes your pack when your dogs and you group to dive. She can peel your W with the shield and displace you out of range before you finish the combo. Flank wide so the ball can't be pre-placed on her, force her to use it defensively, then commit only when it's on the wave.
